description:
Upscale the active document using Generative Upscale (PS 27+).

Use when: increasing resolution with AI detail recovery.
Do NOT use when: generative_upscale flag is false — use photoshop_resize_image.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: generative_upscale capability; signed-in Adobe account.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

name: photoshop_generative_upscale
